# V8.0.2 TEST: dual precision steppers.
        # Left arrows change whole dinars (+/- 1.000); right arrows change fractions (+/- 0.050).
        def step_money(var, delta):
            raw=(var.get() or "").strip()
            try:
                current=self.parse_number(raw) if raw else 0.0
            except Exception:
                current=0.0
            new_value=max(0.0, round(current + delta, 3))
            var.set(f"{new_value:.3f}")
